description: This file is a Makefile used for building and pushing Docker images related to a PyTorch project, with configurations for CUDA versions, Docker tags, and build targets.

methods.name: all
methods.description: Default target to build the development image.

methods.name: devel-push
methods.description: Pushes the development Docker image to the registry.

methods.name: runtime-image
methods.description: Builds the runtime Docker image, varies based on CUDA version.

methods.name: runtime-push
methods.description: Pushes the runtime Docker image to the registry.

methods.name: clean
methods.description: Removes Docker images related to the project.
